//: Accepted dependency risks, read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs.
An entry needs a package, a reason of at least 12 characters, and an expiry
date. All three are ENFORCED, not conventional: an entry missing any of them
is rejected and the finding still blocks, and an expired entry stops
suppressing. That is deliberate — accepting a risk should carry a review date
rather than becoming a line in an ignore file that outlives the person who
understood it. Both rules are falsified in the gate's self-checks.
This list is EMPTY on purpose: every critical and high in the production
dependency tree was fixed within its existing semver range, so nothing needs
accepting today. An empty list is the honest state, not an oversight.
Build-chain findings do not belong here. They never block, so they need no
exception; they are printed as advisory on every run.
